cc:Work.dc:title: Momentum Muon: LR and ELR
cc:Work.dc:description: Prescribed 5% linear warmup followed by linear external LR decay and a heuristic ELR curve for momentum Muon. Constant update RMS and exponentially growing weight squared RMS are modeled across the full run; c0=0.9, kappa=5. Each curve is normalized at warmup completion. Not a proof of optimal LR or an empirical fit. All axes linear.
